name: The Inventory Manager Database
description: An inventory manager tracks stock levels with real arithmetic: read the stock, add or remove items, and watch the counts. 5 products, 100 items in stock. Adding 20 to 80 gives 100. Removing 30 from 100 leaves 70. 10 items at 25.00 is 250.00. Everything runs in this browser; no data leaves the page.
